name: NY-20
label: Safe D

key_factors: Tonko is a well-funded incumbent in a D+8 district
Republican challenger raised only ~$29k with no outside support
No polls or expert ratings, so fundamentals carry the forecast
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Tonko: a D+8 district, incumbency, and a lopsided money advantage against a barely funded challenger, with markets also pricing a Democratic win near certain. With no polls to contradict that picture, the race stays Safe Democratic.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending for Ambrosio or an unusually favorable national environment could narrow the margin, though not plausibly enough to threaten the seat.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Paul Tonko seeks another term in a Capital Region district that leans Democratic by about eight points. He has raised nearly a million dollars and holds a large cash advantage, while Republican Ralph Ambrosio has raised under thirty thousand and drawn no outside support. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, and prediction markets put Tonko's chances around ninety-five percent.

The combination of incumbency, the district's partisan lean, and the fundraising gap makes an upset very unlikely. The main uncertainty is simply how large Tonko's winning margin will be, since the seat has historically been safely Democratic and the challenger lacks the resources to compete seriously.
